skills.description: Track and recommend CCF-A computer science conference papers (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, etc.) based on user research interests. Use when user asks to: track conference papers, follow recent research, build a daily/weekly paper digest, recommend papers from a paper list, run scheduled academic alerts, or find papers about multimodal, vision language models, VLM, CLIP, image caption, visual question answering, text-to-image generation. Do NOT use for: arXiv-only preprints, single-paper Q&A, or citation lookup of known papers.
skills.description_zh: 根据用户的兴趣爱好，跟踪并推荐与计算机科学相关的会议论文（如 NeurIPS、ICML、CVPR、ACL 等）。该功能适用于以下场景：跟踪会议论文、了解最新研究成果、生成每日/每周的论文摘要、从论文列表中推荐相关论文、接收定期学术通知，以及查找与多模态、视觉语言模型、CLIP、图像描述、视觉问答、文本到图像生成相关的论文。请勿将此功能用于以下用途：仅查看 arXiv 上的预印本、针对单篇论文的问答，或查询已知的论文引用信息。
skills.name: topconf-daily
